Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pearland, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle.
The impact was firm enough to push me forward against my seatbelt. I got out briefly to check the damage, then
waited at the scene for the other driver and the responding officer. Since then I have described the collision the same
way each time I have spoken with the adjuster, my doctor, and the body shop: the light was red, I had been stationary
for several seconds, and the other vehicle did not slow down in time. I am the named driver on this policy and I am
submitting this claim on my own behalf. Since the accident I have had persistent stiffness and soreness in my neck
and lower back, which my physician has diagnosed as a neck and back strain. I am currently attending physical
therapy and have been advised to limit lifting and long periods of driving.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
